# <span id="aanchor1"></span> Field Selection

Accessing this screen requires **Application Process - FLOWCAL Options** privileges.

The Field Select screen allows administrators to limit the number of options that are available in certain FLOWCAL drop-down lists. This helps users find appropriate values and prevents users from selecting invalid values.

You can limit selection options for the following meter characteristic and analysis drop-down lists:

- Calculation Method
- Z Method
- Water Vapor Technique
- Water Vapor Method
- Flowing Gas Condition
- Reporting Condition
- Heating Value Condition
- Mass Calculation Method
- Energy Calculation Method

<div class="procedure">

To set the available options in a drop-down list:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  Select **Field Selection** in the **Application** group.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 339;height: 425;" />

3.  Use the drop-down field at the top of the screen to select the list that you want to limit.

4.  Click **Edit**.

5.  Check or uncheck the **Display** checkboxes for each selection option.

    By default, all items are set to display.

6.  Click **Save**.

</div>
